items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I was teaching Lil -- teaching his wife how to arrange, and she was studying scoring under me.

ctx.x: Yes, because Earl Hines was at the Grand Terrace then. I started arranging for Earl Hines and then
Louie came back from California and I arranged -- I was teaching Lil -- teaching his wife how to arrange, and she was studying scoring under me. And --
Well, did you set up a studio in your home?
